name: Dataflows - My Queries
description: My Queries in Dataflow Gen2 will become available in Preview, enabling users to save commonly used Power Query transformations to a personal library and reuse them across multiple dataflows.This preview introduces a reuse‑first authoring model, making it easy to apply proven logic—such as data cleansing steps, business rules, or standard joins—without rebuilding queries from scratch.Key benefits and scenarios:* Reuse common transformation logic across multiple Dataflow Gen2 artifacts to speed up authoring* Reduce duplication and promote more consistent data preparation patterns* Accelerate creation of new dataflows when working with similar source systemsDuring Preview, My Queries is intended for experimentation and early adoption, helping users validate reusable transformation patterns and provide feedback as we continue evolving the experience.
